blurb: Ente Locker is a secure vault for life’s essentials — your most important documents and credentials — protected with end-to-end encryption.
description:
Ente Locker is a secure vault for life’s essentials — your most important documents and credentials — protected with end-to-end encryption.

STORE WHAT MATTERS
• IDs and personal documents
• Financial records and important paperwork
• Credentials and recovery details
• Secure notes

SHARE PRIVATELY
Share specific items with trusted people, on your terms.

EMERGENCY HANDOFF
Set up trusted contacts so the right information can be passed on automatically when it’s needed most.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Your data is encrypted with your keys before it leaves your device, so only you can access it. Ente’s architecture and source code have been audited by Cure53.
